answer: A bond is refunded only after 40 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The signal counter is kept in jade and lotus shows each reset. Anyone as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 40 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4780 identities would post 3237 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
